offering_description.value: Intrepid mines and processes potash and langbeinite in the United States for fertilizer distributors, animal feed manufacturers and industrial buyers. It also supplies water, brine and land access to oil and gas operators.

primary_products.value: Potassium chloride; potassium-magnesium sulfate fertilizer; oilfield water and brine; salt; magnesium chloride

primary_services.value: Oilfield water delivery; surface access and rights-of-way

customer_segment.value: B2B: Fertilizer distributors and dealers, animal feed manufacturers, industrial buyers and oil and gas operators

end_markets.value: Crop agriculture; animal nutrition; oil and gas production; industrial manufacturing; road deicing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Bulk fertilizer, mineral products, water and brine; service fees: Oilfield water delivery; rental or leasing: Surface access and rights-of-way for oilfield operations
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: Extracts potassium-bearing minerals and supplies mineral inputs to fertilizer, feed and industrial buyers; OEM / manufacturer: Processes mined minerals and brines into finished fertilizers sold to agricultural distributors and dealers; service provider: Uses company-controlled water and land to supply oilfield operators
value_chain_position.category: raw materials; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States, with operations in New Mexico and Utah, and specialty fertilizer exports to Latin America and other markets

specialization.value: related lines: Potash, specialty fertilizers, mineral byproducts and oilfield water and land services

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Agricultural fertilizer distributors and dealers, including export distributors; direct sales: Bulk sales to feed manufacturers, industrial buyers and oilfield operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Mine Safety and Health Administration rules, federal and state mining and environmental permits, and state water rights rules

notes: The current scope of oilfield services and the full list of export markets are uncertain.
